title: College travel (stronger)
question:
The chart below shows how students travelled to Northfield College in 2005 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
essay:
The bar chart compares the proportions of students at Northfield College who used five different modes of transport to reach the college in 2005 and 2025.

Overall, the car lost its position as the most common way of travelling, while the bus overtook it and cycling grew more than any other option. Walking was the only other mode to decline.

In 2005, almost two in five students (38%) travelled by car, making it clearly the dominant choice. The bus was the second most popular option at 27%, followed by walking at 18%. Cycling and the train were used by fewer than one in ten students, at 9% and 8% respectively.

By 2025, the picture had changed considerably. The share of car users had fallen by 16 percentage points to 22%, whereas the bus had risen slightly to 30% and become the most popular mode. The most dramatic change was in cycling, which more than doubled to 21%. Train use also increased, to 12%, while the proportion of students who walked dropped modestly to 15%.
